\begin{document}
The density of states of the lead is normalized,
\begin{equation}
\int_{-D}^{D} d\epsilon\, \rho(\epsilon) = 1 .
\label{eq:norm}
\end{equation}
In the wide-band limit we replace it by its value at the Fermi level, $\rho > 0$, so that
the tunneling rate is
\begin{equation}
\frac{\Gamma}{2\pi\rho} = |V|^2 .
\label{eq:gamma}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
